_about: Community patches offered by the title screen's MOD OPTIONS (dlc/modoptions.c, tools/dlc_community.py). Each .ppf is made against the original NTSC-U disc; only its bytes in the executable are used, applied in memory while the patch is chosen. A 'main' patch replaces the game's data and code; an 'extra' goes on top of the game (for: original) or of a main patch (for: its id).
